messages:
maria_support: Hey team, escalated from enterprise customer — Android app keeps getting a silent close mid-SSE stream when the device goes to background during a long generation. They see partial JSON, then connection closed with no error on client.

devon_android: Seeing this from a handful of users too. Repro steps: open chat, start a long streaming reply (~>60s), press home, wait 10–20s, reopen app -> no final token, stream stopped.

maria_support: Customer timeline: request sent at 12:03:12, server sent tokens until 12:04:09 then no more, client logs show socket closed at 12:04:10. Server logs show no explicit disconnect event. They provided the SDK trace.

devon_android: Shared client log snippet:
```
W/Socket: onClose(code=1006, reason=)
I/StreamHandler: received partial chunk: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"..."}}]
I/StreamHandler: stream ended unexpectedly
```

cheng_runtime: Quick check on our side: for that request id we see continuous responses until 12:04:09 then no FIN. Upstream proxy returned a 502 at 12:04:10 for other clients in that region. Possible network path reset.

noah_prodops: Could be a mobile carrier NAT timeout or Android Doze aggressively killing sockets when app backgrounded. Does client set any keepalive or use EventSource polyfill?

devon_android: We use okhttp EventSource + system keepalive. No explicit heartbeat sent. Android network callback shows "lost" at 12:04:10. But the surprising part is server didn't log a socket close / write error.

maria_support: Customer noted this happens more reliably on specific carriers and when switching from wifi -> cellular. Also observed when device locks screen.

sre-bot: DeployBot: Canary 2026-03-15 runtime patch rolled to node group A at 11:50 — no related error spikes.

cheng_runtime: Two hypotheses: 1) intermediate NAT/proxy silently tears TLS connection and client library reports 1006 without server seeing FIN. 2) our idle timeout on the edge is too low for backgrounded mobile. Current edge idle is 65s. Customer workaround time between background and reopen ~>20s though.

noah_prodops: We saw a brief spike in proxy 502s around that time (12:04). Could be unrelated, but we should correlate by AZ and customer region.

devon_android: Short-term: we can add a foreground->background handler to keep a lightweight ping (small GET to /health or SSE ping) while backgrounded. But Android may still suspend it.

maria_support: Customer asked for repro steps + any server-side mitigations. Can we increase edge keepalive or send periodic SSE comments for active streams?

cheng_runtime: We can add an occasional comment frame for long-running streams (every 15s) to keep NATs alive. That needs a change in runtime but low risk. I'll put a small PR. Also recommend increasing idle to 120s at edge for mobile routes.

noah_prodops: I can spin a canary with edge idle=120s for support-tier routes. Will monitor error rates and connection churn.

devon_android: Client-side: implement reconnection with resume token and incremental state handling. If client gets 1006 mid-stream, try to reconnect and request continuation with last-ack token. Provide sample snippet:
```
// pseudo
es.onmessage = (evt) => { persist(evt.data); }
es.onclose = (e) => { if (shouldRetry) reconnectWith(lastPersistedOffset); }
```

maria_support: Thanks. I'll send the customer: repro steps, suggested Android changes, and that we're testing edge idle bump + runtime heartbeat comments.

cheng_runtime: Filed runtime issue IR-784: "SSE soft-heartbeat for long-running token streams" — target patch in 48h.

noah_prodops: Canary started for edge idle=120s. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/edges/conn-churn (watching the mobile-prod filter).

devon_android: Quick note — if we add heartbeat comments, ensure we don't break structured/binary streaming clients. Use `: ping\n\n` style SSE comments per spec.

maria_support: Customer reply: thanks — will try client change and confirm. Marking as action items: runtime PR, edge canary, client recon logic.

sre-bot: IncidentBot: created follow-up ticket SUPPORT-1129 linking request ids and network traces.

maria_support: Closing loop after customer confirms. :thumbsup:
